text:
Moraine
Material: debris deposited along a glacier margin
Retreat record: ridges can mark former ice limits
provenance: Concise factual data extracted from the cited source. Source: US Geological Survey Professional Paper 387-B, Recent activity of glaciers of Mount Rainier; https://pubs.usgs.gov/publication/pp387B. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text:
Medial moraine
Origin: debris bands at adjoining edges of merging glaciers
Position: down the combined glacier
provenance: Concise factual data extracted from the cited source. Source: US Geological Survey, Glossary of Glacier Terminology; https://pubs.usgs.gov/of/2004/1216/text.html. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text:
Tarn
Location: a cirque basin
Origin: commonly follows melting of the glacier that carved the basin
provenance: Concise factual data extracted from the cited source. Source: US Geological Survey, Glossary of Glacier Terminology; https://pubs.usgs.gov/of/2004/1216/text.html. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text:
Rock glacier
Material: rock debris
Form: glacierlike, often occupying a valley beneath a cirque
provenance: Concise factual data extracted from the cited source. Source: US Geological Survey, Glossary of Glacier Terminology; https://pubs.usgs.gov/of/2004/1216/text.html. Consulted 2026-10-13.
